test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the primary function of money?

options.text: It is a store house of goods
It is a medium of exchange
It is the basis of debit
It is the basis of distribution of income

solution:
The correct answer is:** __It is a medium of exchange__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Money is a medium of transaction** that is recognised internationally.
 
• A medium of exchange and a standard of worth, money is essential.
